dedupe_keys.name: ireland inpatient hospital bed days by procedure sex and county department of health table dha103 cso pxstat

description: This table reports inpatient hospital bed days in Ireland by type of procedure, sex and county of residence each year, published by the Department of Health through the Central Statistics Office PxStat database and listed on the national open data portal. It is one of a family of DHA tables on hospital discharges and bed days by principal diagnosis, principal procedure and age group. Coverage is Ireland by county from 2017 to 2025. The data are free to download as CSV, JSON-stat, PX or Excel through the PxStat API under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: bed days are grouped by procedure chapter, so they describe utilisation, not bed capacity; counties are patients' counties of residence, not hospital locations; and table structures change between releases. Simulation uses: estimating baseline bed occupancy by procedure group and area for hospital surge and disruption models in Ireland, and calibrating demand in healthcare capacity planning. Related records: Eurostat hospital beds (data-eurostat-hlth-rs-bds1-hospital-beds) give national bed capacity for comparison, and the Dublin Fire Brigade ambulance incident data (data-dublin-fire-brigade-ambulance-incident-data) cover pre-hospital demand in Ireland.
